translation.name: Iwaperite tajorentsi ikenkithatakoetziri awinkatharite Jesokirishito: owakirari inimotakiri tajorentsi

content: Tekatsi okantya nojankinatantemirori: “Pikaminthaantyaariri piyemijantzinkarite”. Tema piyoperotaki pikamintheeyakirini. Niyotaki tee pithañeeyarini piyorikite, rootaki nokamanantariri masherooniyajatzi: “Okaataki iroñaaka apaani ojarentsi ikowantakari korintojatzi eejatzi paashinipaeni atziri janta kipatsi owaero Akaaya rotyaanteniri jerojareejatzi koriki”. Riyotakoeyakimini, rootaki ikowaperoeyantakarini ikimiteeyemini, retakoeyatyaaririni riroripaeni.

Ari nokanteeyakirini: “Ikowaki korintojatzi rotyaanteniri jerojareejatzi iyorikite”. Iroñaaka notyaanteri riroripaeni reewatanakina, ikantemi pipiyotaperotantyaariri. Nimpaetanee naari noñeeyemini, aririka itsipatanakina paashinipaeni masherooniyajatzi. Aririka iñaapaakimi pipiyotakiniri jerojareejatzi piyorikite, riyoteeyapaakini kyaaryo nokantakiriri, eejatzi eero nopashiwenta naari.

Ari nokantakiri irika ayemijantzinkaritepaeni reewatanakina, pipiyoteeyantyaaririni piyorikite. Eerokapaeni kantashitachari paerani: “Netakotyaari ashironkaenkari”, tee naaka kantaperotemini. Rootaki okameethatantari piperi kameetha.
Tajorentsi ramitakotemi oetarika aririka pamitakoteri paashini atziri oetarikapaeni

Pikenkithashiryaakotero iroka: aririka pipiyoteri piyorikite, pikimiwitakari pankiwaetatsiri: aririka ipankitero osheki okithoki, rowiitero iinja osheki. Omaanta ipankiterorika eechonkiini, ari eechonkiini raye. Eejatzi eeroka, aririka piperi paashini eechonkiini piyorikite eejatzi Tajorentsi apatziro ramitakotemi eechonkiini; omaanta aririka piperi osheki ari osheki ramitakotemi.

Rootaki pikenkithashiryaakoeyeroni kameetha, piyoteeyakini tsika ikaate koriki pikowakiri piperiri. Aritaki ikaataki piperiri. Eero pithañaashiretari, eejatzi eero ishintsitzimi paashinipaeni. Tema Tajorentsi inintashireperotakiri riraga pashitariri weshiryaawentariri. Tema ikoyi pimonkaatero iroka.

Aririka kameetha piperi piyorikite, tema riyotzi Tajorentsi eejatzi ikaminthaaperotakimi kameetha. Aritaki ipakimiro maawaeni koetyeemotakimiri, ipaperotemiro ojeekantyaari, rootaki pimatantyaawori pikaminthaantyaariri eejatzi paashinipaeni.

content.text: “Riraga oyaatziriri Tajorentsi ipashitagaantari rowaagawo owashironkaenkari. Tee ratsipetashita ikamintheeyirini irirapaeni, eerokya ipeyakotziro Tajorentsi ikaminthaantzi. Tema Tajorentsi imatakaakiri eekiro riyaatatye ipashitari paashinipaeni”.

content: Riraga Tajorentsi ipapiintziri pankiwaetatsiri okithoki ipankitantyaawori, eejatzi ipapiinteeyakaeni owaeyarini. Tema eejatzi roshekitanakimiro tzimimoeyemirini ojeekantyaari pikaminthagaeyantyaaririni ashironkaenkari.
Eekiro riyaatakaatyeemi Tajorentsi petakotaperotantyaariri paashinipaeni. Roojatzi ipaasonkiteeyerini rirori, iñaaperotaperoeyerini.
Aririka etakotantya aari, apaperoteri aapatziyariri Jesoshi riraga ashironkaenkari koetyeemotakariri. Omaanta eejatzi ayotagaeyerini ipaasonkiteeyerini Tajorentsi.

Aririka pikaminthagaeyerini piyemijantzinkarite, riyoteeyanakini rirori kyaaryo eeroka rirotaki aapatziyaperoeyaririni Jesokirishito kimitaka pikantzi. Eejatzi riyoteeyanakini tee pithañeeyari piyorikite, omaanta osheki petakotantaka, roojatzi iñaaperoeyerini Tajorentsi.
Osheki ikenkithashireeyakimini, eejatzi osheki ramanapiintziri Tajorentsi ramitakoeyemini. Riyoteeyakini oshekipero ineshironkateeyakimini Tajorentsi.

Thame apaasonkiteeyerini irira okaatzi ipashitakaeri, tema ikaminthaaperoeyakaeniwee: rotyaantakaeri Itomi Jesoshi ikamawentakae rowawijaakotanteeri. Tee amatziro athotyeero ayotero tsika okaatzika ipashitakaeri.
